teamName: Opportunity Intelligence / OUCS — Pain & Remedy Extension
purpose: Extend Run 011 so every material signal is evaluated for forward value, pain inversion, reverse-business opportunities, executable remedies, evidence-backed economics, Factory fit and explicit kill criteria, with owner-discovered misses converted into regression tests.

reuseEvidence: Run 011 Opportunity Intelligence / OUCS ownership reviewed
Factory Core hybrid component rules reused
a0Decision.residualUnownedLoop: Pain inversion, reverse-business analysis, remedy mapping and missed-opportunity regression were not permanently owned.

capabilities.name: Opportunity Intelligence Control
capabilities.responsibility: Own bounded signal routing, run identity, typed handoffs, terminal states and authority accounting.

capabilities.name: Opportunity Signal Normalizer
capabilities.responsibility: Normalize incoming technology, dataset, regulatory, platform, market and complaint signals into a common evidence-linked packet.

capabilities.name: Pain and Remedy Radar
capabilities.responsibility: Perform pain inversion and reverse-business analysis while separating observed facts from hypotheses and naming required falsification evidence.

capabilities.name: Remedy Mapper
capabilities.responsibility: Map lawful technical, legal, informational and operational remedies, authorization requirements, automation path, residue, failure modes and kill criteria.

capabilities.name: Market Evidence Packager
capabilities.responsibility: Package attributable evidence of payment, substitutes, demand, complaints, incumbent pricing and adoption without inventing validation.

capabilities.name: Factory Fit Mapper
capabilities.responsibility: Map candidate requirements to existing Factory capabilities, missing adapters, expected human work and measurable implementation gaps.

capabilities.name: Sensitive Scope Gate
capabilities.responsibility: Fail closed on raw personal-profile resale, stalking/doxxing, minor targeting, regulated eligibility decisioning and other disallowed sensitive-data opportunity patterns.

capabilities.name: Deterministic Opportunity Scorer
capabilities.responsibility: Apply the fixed 100-point nine-dimension rubric and cap evidence-free or kill-criteria-free candidates at WATCH.

capabilities.name: Missed Opportunity Regression Registry
capabilities.responsibility: Persist owner-discovered misses, root causes, expected concepts and calibration cases so discovery improvements can be regression tested.

capabilities.name: Opportunity Regression Runner
capabilities.responsibility: Run all MISS cases and fail when expected opportunity concepts, safety gates or minimum scores are not recovered.

capabilities.name: Independent Opportunity Q3
capabilities.responsibility: Independently challenge evidence, scoring, remedy viability, regulatory assumptions and Factory-fit claims before VALIDATED is permitted.

capabilities.name: Opportunity Registry Adapter
capabilities.responsibility: Prepare typed registry records and next-action packages without claiming downstream acceptance or execution.

capabilities.name: Owner Opportunity Decision
capabilities.responsibility: Retain strategy, capital, launch, external-action and material-risk approval authority.
